items.source: Create a chat completion message with the given content and role.
items.translation: 请提供具体的聊天内容（message content）和角色（role），以便我为您生成对应的中文翻译。

items.source:
Create a chat completion message with the given content and role. All other
fields are null.
items.translation: 创建一个带有给定内容和角色的聊天完成消息。所有其他字段均为空值。

items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类，且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。

items.source: Returns a string representation of this record class. The representation contains the name of the class, followed by the name and value of each of the record components.

items.source: role - The role of the messages author. Could be one of the DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionMessage.Role types.
items.translation: role - 消息作者的角色。可以是 DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionMessage.Role 枚举类型中的一种。

items.source: toolCallId - Tool call that this message is responding to. Only applicable for the DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionMessage.Role.TOOL role and null otherwise.
items.translation: toolCallId - 此消息所响应的工具调用。仅适用于 DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionMessage.Role.TOOL 角色，否则为 null。

items.source: toolCalls - The tool calls generated by the model, such as function calls. Applicable only for DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionMessage.Role.ASSISTANT role and null otherwise.
items.translation: toolCalls - 模型生成的工具调用，例如函数调用。 仅适用于 DeepSeekApi.ChatCompletionMessage.Role.ASSISTANT 角色，否则为 null。
